{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders from 'loyal' customers
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
loyal_completed['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(loyal_completed['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Count valid revenue entries (non-null)
valid_count = loyal_completed['revenue'].notnull().sum()

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print the required numbers
print(f"Valid completed orders from loyal customers: {valid_count}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
